## Voice Training

### Selene Archive
An organized collection of Selene Da Silva's clips.
<br />https://selenearchive.github.io

### TransVoiceLessons
A very well-known source for voice training knowledge.
<br />https://www.youtube.com/@TransVoiceLessons

### Trans Academy VODs
VR chat voice modulation workshops.
<br />https://www.youtube.com/@transacademyvods

### Vinh Giang
Vinh Giang is a communication coach. Although this is not trans related, some of
his techniques may indirectly help with voice training or shape overall confidence.
<br />https://www.youtube.com/@askvinh

## HRT

### Trans Harm Reduction
A volunteer-run, grassroots organization helping trans people in Ireland and Scotland
reduce the risk of harm when self-medicating.
<br />https://transharmreduction.org

### The DIY HRT Directory 2.0
A safer use guide on how to perform DIY Hormone Replacement Therapy.
<br />https://diyhrt.info
